description: This PHP source file defines an API class for managing termination reason configurations in a Human Resource Management system. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting termination reasons, with validation rules and integration with underlying service and data layers.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI
classes.description: API class for managing termination reason configurations including CRUD operations, validation rules, and integration with underlying services.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the TerminationReasonConfigurationService instance.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all termination reasons with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for parameters of the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new termination reason.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Saves a termination reason entity with the provided name.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a termination reason.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove termination reasons by IDs after validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation, ensuring IDs are valid and not in use.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific termination reason by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single termination reason by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing termination reason.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a termination reason, including uniqueness checks.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for the 'name' field, with optional exclusion for unique validation during updates.
